title: Native integration workbench
summary: Added a native-safe C# command surface for integration, content and local history.

title: Detached commit launch
summary: Starts a detached worker and returns its PID without waiting for Git commits.

title: Immutable commit snapshots
summary: Copies source bytes before queuing so later edits cannot enter earlier commits.

title: Serialized private-index commits
summary: Builds local Git trees from saved bytes with a private index and serialized HEAD updates.

title: Exclusive commit worker
summary: Prevents concurrent workers from racing on the local branch and queue.

title: Bounded process execution
summary: Uses argument lists, child timeouts and captured diagnostics without shell interpolation.

title: Source-backed integration ledger
summary: Requires25 distinct changes with existing source anchors and content hashes.

title: Checkpoint attempt retention
summary: Executes requested25-step gates and retains failed and successful timestamped attempts.

title: ELF section accounting
summary: Reads bounded ELF32 section tables and excludes container/debug bytes from image size.

title: RAM-resident code budgeting
summary: Counts code, data, BSS, alignment and the separate4096-byte boot reserve.

title: Measured HTML generation
summary: Builds the introduction using measured byte counts and the exact firmware digest.

title: Immutable content compiler
summary: Compiles bounded HTML into static C++ byte arrays and records the source digest.

title: Loopback page preview
summary: Provides a local host preview independent of an unimplemented board Ethernet stack.

title: One-thread nano application
summary: Introduces a real minimal application with one512-byte worker stack and no diagnostics buffers.

title: Independent nano build profile
summary: Disables optional services and sets a512-byte idle stack and one application slot.

title: Selectable firmware application
summary: Allows independent example images without editing the firmware target source list.

title: Validated native host bundle
summary: Rejects prebuilt tools whose host identity or source digest differs from current inputs.

title: Read-only byte views
summary: Adds explicit pointer-length views with null/nonempty validation for transport and asset input.

title: Writable byte views
summary: Separates destination capacity from immutable source buffers without allocating.

title: Checked size arithmetic
summary: Rejects overflowing lengths while preserving the caller's result on failure.

title: Saturating health counters
summary: Keeps resource-pressure counters from wrapping silently.

title: Bounded ring insertion
summary: Adds drop-newest backpressure and a saturating exhaustion count to fixed storage.

title: FIFO ring consumption
summary: Consumes fixed ring slots in FIFO order across wrap without changing output on empty.

title: Generation-tagged static loans
summary: Prevents stale release and retires exhausted generations without heap fallback.

title: Quarantined pool ownership
summary: Removes unsafe loans from reuse and exposes conservation checks.
